stressTest.title: Concurrency Stress Test
stressTest.description: Launch massive concurrent requests to demonstrate Effect's optimistic locking and fiber concurrency safely rejecting overbookings.
stressTest.targetFlightIdHelp: Pick a flight ID (you can find one via the regular search)
stressTest.requestCountHelp: Number of identical booking commands to fire simultaneously
stressTest.explanationIntro: When dozens of travelers try to book exactly the same seat at the same time, this test shows how our system processes them simultaneously:
stressTest.explanationPoint1: Only the first to arrive get a seat (Successful), without ever exceeding the plane's capacity.
stressTest.explanationPoint2: The others are cleanly rejected. Either because two people clicked at the exact same moment on the same seat (Opt. Locking), or because the plane is truly full (Flight Full).
stressTest.explanationPoint3: Result: Zero crashes, zero accidental overbookings, your database stays perfectly healthy!
